name: Piotr Wójcik
detail: The 2020 column favours property and income reform first and postpones a general wealth tax; do not treat its report of Razem's proposal as his endorsement.

name: Ludwik Kotecki
detail: The examined money.pl column describes his proposed wealth tax as a cadastral property tax; obtain his original interview before attributing net-wealth-tax support.

name: Adrian Zandberg
detail: The examined February 2020 interview advocates progressive income taxation; party membership does not establish personal support for the separate wealth-tax proposal.
